entries.body:
Summary of progress so far (stages 1-2 released; stage 3 not yet released)

Stage 1 key facts:
- stage-1/config/returns-svc.yaml holds repo defaults. These are overridden by release notes and APPLIED records.
  - line 7: clients.tax-engine.timeout_ms: 2500
  - line 11: database.pool.max_size: 48
  - line 12: acquire_timeout_ms: 5000
  - line 14: cache.ttl_s: 120
- stage-1/deploy/deploys.log:3: 2031-04-19T08:16:14Z DEPLOY returns-svc build 6.33.4-cb27 (previous 6.32.5), rollout 100%. Other deploys are unrelated.
- stage-1/deploy/release-notes-6.33.4-cb27.md:
  - line 5: tax-engine timeout_ms default 2500 -> 750
  - line 19: db.pool.max_size default 48 -> 10 "to fit the shared-db connection quota"
  - line 20: TLS session tickets rotated hourly
  - line 21: ff-legacy-export removed (was 0%)
- stage-1/logs/returns-svc.log:
  - "tax-engine timed out after 750ms" starts at line 161 (08:17:17Z), also lines 164 and 256.
  - "db pool wait (in_use 10/10)" WARNs at lines 193, 201 and 614.
- Ruled out as noise: disk at 70%, dns retry succeeded, TLS cert has 34 days left (not expired), gc pauses.
- Not yet done: stage-1/logs/edge-gw.log has no ERROR/WARN tokens and has not been grepped for 5xx.

Stage 2 (09:30-10:30 UTC):
- stage-2/UPDATE.md: a mitigation stopped the tax-engine timeouts, but edge-gw still returns 503s for returns-svc with a different error.
- stage-2/deploy/changes.log:
  - line 1: 2031-04-19T09:44:12Z CHG-5395 APPLIED returns-svc override clients.tax-engine.timeout_ms=4000 (was 750 from build 6.33.4-cb27) by j.moreau; mitigation.
  - line 2: CHG-5396 PROPOSED fulfil-svc http.max_body_kb=512. Not applied and irrelevant.
- stage-2/ops/oncall-notes.md (informal):
  - line 5: 09:54 timeouts stopped, but 503s continue.
  - line 6: 10:04 suspects db pool exhaustion, but cites yaml max_size 48. That is stale: the build default is 10 (release-notes:19).
- stage-2/logs/returns-svc.log:
  - Old 750ms timeout errors appear only before the mitigation (lines 3, 4, 14 at ~09:30-09:31).
  - New dominant ERROR from line 235 (09:47:04.675Z, a70): "db pool exhausted: 10/10 connections in use, waited 5000ms (acquire_timeout)". Also line 236 (b92) and line 251 (e79).

Current hypothesis:
- DB_POOL_EXHAUSTED is now leading.
- CLIENT_TIMEOUT_TOO_LOW was the original cause but is now mitigated by CHG-5395.
- Effective values: pool max_size 10 (release-notes line 19; no APPLIED override yet), timeout 4000.
- Tentative answer:
  - root_cause: DB_POOL_EXHAUSTED
  - required_value: 10
  - remedy: RAISE_DB_POOL_LIMIT (back to 48 or higher)
  - refs:
    - symptom: stage-2/logs/returns-svc.log:235-251
    - current value and original change: stage-1/deploy/release-notes-6.33.4-cb27.md:19

Next steps:
- Not yet read: stage-2/metrics/returns-svc.csv (pool in_use/latency) and stage-2/logs/edge-gw.log (find 503 line numbers for the symptom ref).
- Then advance to stage 3. Watch for APPLIED changes to db.pool.max_size or other settings (the latest APPLIED wins, PROPOSED is ignored) and for a shift in the dominant symptom.

Workspace: /task/workspace/notes.txt contains stage-1 refs plus "s2 released".

[step 5] advance
thought: Stage 2 shifts to DB pool exhaustion (10/10). Advance to stage 3.

Stage 3 of 3 released.
# Stage 3 of 3 (10:30-11:30 UTC)

Another change was applied (see stage-3/deploy/changes.log) and errors persist at a lower rate.
This is the final evidence stage. Give your final diagnosis once you have reviewed it.

New files:
  stage-3/UPDATE.md (4 lines)
  stage-3/deploy/changes.log (6 lines)
  stage-3/logs/edge-gw.log (366 lines)
  stage-3/logs/returns-svc.log (830 lines)
  stage-3/metrics/returns-svc.csv (61 lines)
